name: Deno Deploy Free
free_limit: Free Deno Deploy: 1M inbound requests/month, 20 GiB egress/month, 5 custom domains, 10 active CPU hours and 150 GiB-hours of memory time
watch_out: Free resources are metered independently across applications, egress, CPU and memory; idle apps shut down after about 20–30 seconds. Pro/Builder tiers add higher limits and usage charges; Free does not include unrestricted always-on compute.
